title: Throttle
description:
Implement a `throttle` function that ensures `fn` is called at most once per `limit` ms. The first call fires immediately; subsequent calls within the window are ignored.

**Example:**
```js
const log = throttle(() => console.log('tick'), 200);
log(); // fires immediately
log(); // ignored (within 200ms)
setTimeout(log, 200); // fires again
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using setTimeout to schedule future calls instead of simply tracking the last call timestamp. Also forgetting to fire on the first call immediately.
